definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with the female reproductive organs, and the hospital department or clinic that provides it. Often combined with obstetrics as {産婦人科|さんふじんか}.

examples.japanese: {婦人科|ふじんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{生理痛|せいりつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{婦人科|ふじんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My period pain was so bad that I went to a gynecology clinic.

examples.japanese: {婦人科|ふじんか}⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It is a good idea to have regular gynecological checkups even when you have no symptoms.

notes:
USAGE:
Like other department names (⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧, ⟦{眼科|がんか}→眼科：11071_ganka⟧), {婦人科|ふじんか} names both the field and the place: {婦人科|ふじんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ means going to see a gynecologist.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {婦人科|ふじんか}⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧: gynecological checkup
- {婦人科|ふじんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to see a gynecologist
- {婦人科|ふじんか}{医|い}: gynecologist

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{産婦人科|さんふじんか}→産婦人科：16784_sanfujinka⟧: obstetrics and gynecology, the commonest clinic name
- {産科|さんか}: obstetrics
